sync.title: Shaping Public Policy with AI Economics
sync.rawTitle: #7 - Gianmarco Mazzocchi: Shaping Public Policy with AI Economics | Leading in AI Podcast
sync.youtubeDescription:
Gianmarco Mazzocchi is a global leader in AI economics and policy strategy. With an extensive background spanning investment banking in Frankfurt and consulting across the Middle East, Gianmarco built the AI Economics Unit at Whiteshield from the ground up. He leads a team leveraging cutting-edge machine learning and unconventional data to advise world governments on macroeconomic strategy and public policy, and recently launched the Global Labour Resilience Index at the World Economic Forum in Davos.

In this episode, Gianmarco shares what it really takes to establish a brand-new AI function inside a global firm, how slow-moving governments are deploying machine learning, and where the debate on LLM scaling limitations stands today.

Topics covered:
- The journey: From investment banking and consulting to leading AI Economics
- Building from scratch: Establishing an AI function inside a global consulting firm
- Defining AI Economics and its practical application on the global stage
- Deploying AI in government: Constraints and challenges vs. the private sector
- Satellite imagery and exotic data: Using unconventional sources for policy insights
- AI at Davos: The core message behind the Global Labour Resilience Index
- Responsible AI: Navigating bias, opacity, and transparency in public policy
- The LLM ceiling debate: Are we hitting a wall on the path to AGI?
